_about: Presentation data for Mythic cards (render only, no gameplay effect). Keyed by exact card name. Read by the renderer; written by whichever lane designs a Mythic; the 'ward', 'source' and 'generated' fields are filled by the mythic-wards GitHub Action (.github/workflows/mythic-wards.yml + render/tools/mythic_ward.py).
_howToAddAMythic: Add an entry keyed by the card's exact name with: faction, behaviour, behaviourParams (if any), motif {concept, outer, middle, core, ornament} and sound.

Write the motif in plain visual terms drawn from the card's own ability and flavour. No letters, numbers, real-world emblems, religious/occult/political symbols, stars, hexagrams, pentagrams, crosses, eyes, hearts or crescents.

Leave out 'ward'. The action generates it (at most 3 per run, about $0.15 each) and commits the art; until then the renderer draws the code-generated fallback ward seeded from the card name and faction.

behaviour is one of: seats (lights one seat per counted thing; behaviourParams.counts names what), aura (tethers + crests on allies; pressure ring on enemies if it has an enemy effect), heartbeat (pulse + spawns ornaments that travel to allies), gravity (bends the grid toward it + ornaments spiral in), generic (rotation + pulse only).

signatureAbilities._about: Abilities unique to a Rare or Mythic that call the faction ward when they fire (attack, buff or defence; a debuff on an enemy counts as an attack). Keyed by card name -> list of ability ids. Owner-approved 2026-10-04 (10 entries). The ward flares only the FIRST time an ability fires on a given card instance, never on repeats (recurring ticks, later triggers). Ordinary attacks, arrivals and deaths never show a faction ward; Neutral has no ward.

motif.ornament: one single seat-node: a small rounded rectangle with a glowing indicator light
